new_result.name: QFORM-SPECTRAL-THRESHOLD-FOOTPRINT-COMPILER-v1
new_result.statement: For symmetric H and original-coordinate banks I,J, ||H[I,J]||op is at most the minimum of the two one-sided H^2 compression square-roots and the geometric mean of the two |H| compression norms. Therefore A=A0+H+L+T with ||L||op<=h and ||T||op<=delta preserves any protected cross-block certificate with perturbation budget chi(H;I,J)+h+delta. A spectral threshold split makes arbitrarily many small signed eigenvalues cost only h and arbitrarily large signed eigenvalues cost only physical footprint chi.
new_result.explicit_partner_application: For M0=2I8 with eight simultaneous arbitrary signed eigenvalue replacements, chi<=1/40 and combined small/dense tail norm<=1/40 imply epsilon<=1/20; partner gate margin 2483/800>0 and continuous density bound 5.602062744709504.
new_result.continuity: proved in the cited volume-stability and collective cross-energy branches; not proved for unrestricted full target
